payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Transformer model outperformed the ConvS2S model across all languages, making it the best performing model.

claims.text: The Transformer model outperformed the ConvS2S model for all languages, achieving sometimes 10 BLEU points or more.
The results show that translations using BPE tokenisation with the Transformer model outperformed those using standard word-based tokenisation.
The ConvS2S model struggled with translations, particularly for isiZulu, indicating inferior performance compared to the Transformer model.
